chunks: The forgiveness of a king preserves the kingdom longer.

key_terms.عَفْوُ الْمَلِكِ: The ruler’s pardon and clemency toward others.

ai.seo_question: How does forgiveness by a ruler help preserve a kingdom?
ai.summary: This saying teaches that clemency and pardon are among the qualities that strengthen and prolong political authority. It presents forgiveness in leadership as a cause for the endurance and stability of rule.
